# Prish Capitals

> Prish Capitals is a premier financial and tax consultancy firm headquartered in Govindarajanagar, Bangalore, Karnataka, India, providing end-to-end GST compliance, Income Tax Return (ITR) filing, MSME Udyam registration, corporate accounting, and business licensing services.

## Overview & Entity Profile
- **Firm Name**: Prish Capitals
- **Founder**: Sachin Kumar
- **Experience**: 7+ years of professional practice in Indian corporate & taxation law
- **Headquarters**: 80/9 2nd Floor, 6th Cross, Govindarajanagar, Bangalore 560079, Karnataka, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 12.9716, Longitude 77.5426
- **Primary Contact**: +91 96206 84451 / +91 99951 04594
- **Official Email**: prishcapitals@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday - Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 11:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
- **Service Coverage**: Bangalore, Karnataka, and nationwide across India

## Core Services
- [Home](https://prishcapitals.vercel.app/): Main portal, firm overview, client reviews, and direct consultation booking.
- [Services](https://prishcapitals.vercel.app/services): Complete breakdown of tax, compliance, and corporate accounting services.
  - **GST Services**: New GSTIN registration, monthly GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B filings, annual GSTR-9 audits, Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation, and notice resolution.
  - **Income Tax Services**: Accurate ITR filing for individuals (salaried/freelancers) and corporations (ITR-1 to ITR-7), tax optimization planning, TDS management, and tax notice representation.
  - **Accounting & Bookkeeping**: Monthly ledger maintenance, bank reconciliation, Profit & Loss statements, balance sheets, and audit preparation.
  - **Business Registrations**: Udyam MSME certification, Trade Licenses, Shop & Establishment permits, Partnership firm deeds, and Import-Export Code (IEC).
- [About Us](https://prishcapitals.vercel.app/about): Company mission, core values of integrity and excellence, and message from founder Sachin Kumar.
- [Why Choose Us](https://prishcapitals.vercel.app/why-choose-us): Key differentiators including 98% client satisfaction, 150+ happy clients, 99+ completed projects, and dedicated personalized advisory.
- [Testimonials](https://prishcapitals.vercel.app/testimonials): Verified client reviews and ratings from Indian business owners and startup founders.
- [Contact Us](https://prishcapitals.vercel.app/contact): Consultation request form, Google Maps directions, and direct contact details.
